prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize Your Official Adoption Certificate", "Customize your pet's official name, personality traits, and registry badge before bringing them to your desktop.", "Official Desktop Companion Certificate"]
1: ["Save Your Companion To Cloud", "Sign in now so your newly picked companion is safely saved to your account and synced across devices."]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Screen Habitat", "Select where your companion sits on your screen and how it anchors to your desktop windows.", "Select Dock Location (Taskbar, Screen Top, Free Float)", "Confirm Habitat Location"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Engine & Verifying Display", "While your pet is being generated, we are verifying display anchors and graphics driver compatibility.", "Desktop Render Anchor Check", "Pet Generation Progress"]
4: ["Signing into an existing account automatically restores all saved pets without overwriting data.", "Safe Account Restore Guaranteed"]
5: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "Turn a real photo into an animated companion or adopt from our handcrafted virtual species.", "Custom Photo Creation vs Handcrafted Preset Adoption"]
6: ["Did you know? You can right-click your pet on the desktop to access quick commands and feeding options!", "Test Companion Vocal Sound"]
7: ["Welcome Home! Starter Care Bundle Unlocked", "Your new desktop pet has arrived with 3 starter toys and a welcome pack of food ready on your desktop.", "Unlocked: 3 Desktop Toys & 50 Treats", "Meet Your Pet On Desktop"]
8: ["We'll play a gentle sound chime when your companion is ready to spawn on your desktop.", "Sound Alert When Ready Enabled"]
9: ["Upload Clear Photo For Best 3D Results", "For best results, use a bright, front-facing photo with your pet's face fully visible.", "Select Front-Facing Pet Photo", "Tip: Avoid dark shadows, side angles, or blurry photos for accurate 3D model creation."]
